My husband had just come back from London late at night after a long and difficult journey, where he picked me up in Salisbury before taking me to Portsmouth for work. It was an inconvenient trip for him, especially with road closures, and he still had another drive back to Winchester ahead of him, where he had to wake up early for work the next day.

When I realized I had forgotten my phone charger, I texted him to bring me one. However, he didn’t have one in the car and would have had to go back to work, grab the charger, and then come back to deliver it before returning to Winchester. He offered to bring it the next evening after work instead, pointing out that I still had my iPad and that he could contact me through my landlady if there was an emergency. He also says he had politely reminded me multiple times to charge my phone and even asked if I had everything before we left the house. 

However, this time, he decided to "teach me a lesson" by not bringing the charger immediately, intending to reinforce that I need to be more responsible with my phone. I became very upset and told him how serious the situation was to me, even threatening to divorce him over it.

AITA for insisting my husband drop everything and bring me a phone charger that night?

AITA for blowing up at my in laws and wife over them trying to ruin our vacation plans? My wife and I have 2 kids (4f & 2f). We moved to another country about a year ago and have been living here ever since. When in our home country, both families were very involved in our lives due to my kids being the only grandchildren on both sides. Us moving overseas caused my in laws to feel as if we were abandoning them and they will lose the bond they have with their grandkids and we only doing it for the money and not thinking about them. So we agreed during summers we will send the kids back home for about 6 weeks to spend time with both grandparents.

In September my wife and I explored the idea of going for a vacation without the kids to reconnect and be a couple again. We discussed and she agreed that it will be good for us. We then speak to my inlaws and explain to them when and why we want to go for our solo holiday. They were very excited at the prospect of spending time with the kids so all seemed well. Now, knowing that my in laws can be very reactionary people I told them to think about it and we will discuss again in a few days time. We call them 3 days later and discuss and they of the same mindset. As i said i know how reactionary they can be so i brought it up with them every 2 or 3 days  for about a month which is ALOT of discussion around the same subject. I wanted to make sure all is fine. This is what we agreed to:

1. Wife and kids will fly home late December to leave the kids and to get the kids used to the grand parents again and vice versa
2. Wife will return late Jan so she can spend some time here and do some things she wanted to do without having to worry about the kids
3. Early Feb wife and I will depart for Bali after which we will go to home country to spend some time
4. So in total, we will be leaving the kids in their care for 4 weeks

On Monday my in laws ask her if she is serious about leaving the kids for so long and that they are worried that the kids won't manage and she must push her flight later so the kids only spend the minimum amount of time without us - they want her to fly back only a day or two before we leave for vacation as opposed to the 2 weeks that has been planned and paid for. She called me on Monday night to talk to me about it and said that she AGREES with them I. Lost. My. Shit. I demanded a conference call with her parents straight away and basically let them have it for emotionally manipulating my wife. I said if they try and demand this I will take my kids with us to Bali and they can forget about us ever leaving the kids with them again and I will not be sending them down over the summers. I said I will not ask them for anything ever again and called them assholes for not keeping to the agreement even though we discussed it more than 20 times.I told my wife this is bullshit as she was fine with the arrangements whenever we discussed it. I said she needs to grow a spine and stick to her decision.

AITA?

My 21F best friend “K” had a birthday party back in 2019. Days before her party she asked me and our other best friend “A” for money since she haven’t gotten her birthday gift from her parents (which is the money she will use to pay for the expenses for her party). She told us she would pay me and A as soon as she got her money so me and A chipped in to pay for her party. 3 years later, she still hasn’t paid us back. There were multiple times when me and A asked her if she can pay us back. But each time we ask her, she will just apologize, tell us she doesn’t have any money at the moment, and promise that she will pay us back once she have money. 

But it has been 3 years already. We went out countless of times already but she never paid us back. I don’t know if she forgot she owes us money but It’s just awkward to keep asking her to pay when it should’ve have been her responsibility to pay us back even if we don’t ask. Now I’m thinking of asking her again to pay me back because I desperately need the money but I am too shy to ask. Should I just forget that she owes us money or should I still ask her to pay? I desperately need money right now and the only way I can think of is to get that money back. What should I do?

TL;DR
My best friend borrowed money from me 3 years ago and she still hasn’t paid me back. I need money right now and am thinking to ask her to pay me back. Should I still ask her or should I just forget she owes me money because it has been 2 years already?

Update: Sorry for the late update. I got caught up with school and family stuff but thank you all for showing concern in my personal matter. I didn’t expect for this post to blow up. I saw most of the comments saying that I shouldn’t lend money and expect it to come back. I get this know. But here in my country, we have this thinking that it is much safer to lend money to our family and friends (if they need it) since they are closer to us and they are the ones who we trust more in paying us back our money. Well I learned the hard way that even your best friend you can’t trust 100%. And if you guys are wondering if I talked to her or what, I didn’t. You guys are right, the money is gone. What I will do is to never lend her or anyone anything ever again. I think if ever I will loan anybody again is if only they badly need it (eg. medical bills, any emergency stuff, etc). Anyway, thank you so much again you guys for taking time to make me realize things. Hope all are well.
I've talked to her directly and I think the only appropriate retaliation is now to blast music at 5 am when I get up since I know she doesn't get to bed until 1ish.
